title: calliandra mollicula
intro: Calliandra mollicula, commonly known as the pink powder puff, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems, thanks to its numerous health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calliandra mollicula include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and alleviating symptoms of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
